The surrounding code opens `<%- if @topic_view.posts.present? %>`, but the terminator is malformed, so rendering /embed/best (and even the no-post branch, since compilation fails regardless of runtime values) would raise ActionView::Template::Error. This is a real defect introduced by this diff.

adjudication.rationale: In app/views/embed/best.html.erb the header conditional is closed with `<%- end if %>`, which inserts the Ruby code `end if` into the template. This is invalid Ruby syntax because `if` requires a condition (it is not `end if <cond>`), so the ERB template would fail to compile and rendering /embed/best would raise an ActionView::Template::Error (500).
